_about: Per-card voice casting for individual minions -- distinct from voice-lines.json, which is keyed by hero PrimaryClass (8 voices, one per class). A legendary or epic minion here can use ANY voice, including one already cast to a hero class (Sam, 2026-09-27): there is no collision rule to check. Lines are written and dispatched in a later pass; this file exists to pin the casting decision as it's made, before the lines exist.
